[[File:Lars Jonsson, Waldemarsudde 2012.JPG|thumb|Lars Jonsson]]
'''Lars Jonsson''' (born 1952 in Stockholm) is a [[Sweden|Swedish]] [[ornithology|ornithological]] [[illustrator]] living in [[Hamra, Gotland|Hamra]] in the south part of the Swedish island of [[Gotland]]. He was appointed an [[honorary degree]] by [[Uppsala University]] in 2002.<ref>{{cite web|last=Hogdal |first=Jon |title=Pressmeddelande 2002-03-23. Konstnär och musikforskare nya hedersdoktorer |url=http://info.uu.se/press.nsf/pm/konstnar.och.idB9.html |publisher=Uppsala Universitet |accessdate = 22 March 2002|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070925071444/http://info.uu.se/press.nsf/pm/konstnar.och.idB9.html |archive-date=2007-09-25 }}</ref>
